endpoints.endpointName: Outer Gooley Parking Area / Hudson Gorge carry
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: hudson_river_newcomb_indian_confluence outer-gooley-hudson-river-takeout: NYSDEC publishes the Town of Newcomb launch, Polaris Bridge parking area and 0.3-mile carry to the hand launch, and Outer Gooley parking area with a 0.1-mile carry to the marked take-out. The stored points are public access/parking anchors; only the Newcomb point is the published launch location. Verify seasonal roads, carries, and the marked landings.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (hudson_river_newcomb_indian_confluence outer-gooley-hudson-river-takeout) on Hudson River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.

endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: hudson_river_indian_confluence_north_river north-river-hudson-gorge-takeout: NYSDEC identifies the Outer Gooley parking area and 0.1-mile carry to the marked Hudson River access; American Whitewater describes the Old Gooley path as the gorge put-in when a release is not being used. The stored point is the parking/carry anchor, not the water entry. Verify the seasonal road, current carry, access rules, and marked landing.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (hudson_river_indian_confluence_north_river north-river-hudson-gorge-takeout) on Hudson River; treat the agency parking/carry anchor as on/near-water evidence, but confirm the exact water entry and landing before launch.
